name: ism868-pulses
description: Detect every short-range transmission between 867.5 and 869.5 MHz at once (the 868 MHz SRD band and the sensor channels up to 869 MHz): an 8-channel polyphase channelizer and a pulse detector in every channel, the pulse trains as packets.

rf.description: RTL-SDR IQ at 2 MS/s centred at 868.5 MHz

pulses.description: Pulse trains (sdrk_proto::pulses), indexed in steps of 500 kHz
